title: Roasted Beetroot Salad
description: A simple salad featuring roasted beetroot as the main ingredient, complemented by a variety of Mediterranean flavors. Prep time is minimal, but the salad is best served after a few hours of refrigeration to allow the flavors to meld.

ingredients.name: Beetroot
ingredients.notes: Choose beets that are heavy for their size

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality extra virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: Balsamic vinegar
ingredients.notes: Look for a good-quality aged balsamic

ingredients.name: Red onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the onion before adding

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh parsley adds a nice texture and flavor

ingredients.name: Feta cheese
ingredients.notes: Crumble the feta cheese over the salad just before serving

instructions: 2. Wrap the beetroot in foil and roast in the oven for 45-50 minutes, or until tender when pierced with a fork.
3. Allow the beetroot to cool, then peel and chop into bite-sized pieces.
4. In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
5. Add the chopped beetroot, red onion, and chopped parsley to the bowl and toss to combine.
6. Season the salad with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Just before serving, crumble the feta cheese over the salad and toss to combine.
